_comment: MiniMax H3 image-to-video on the v4 turbo graph (64) with Spectrum patched in between the sigma shift and the sampler. Spectrum replaces some transformer evaluations with a Chebyshev ridge forecast, so it only pays on a LONG schedule: run this with the LoRA at strength 0 and steps at 20, which is the path it was written for. On the 4-step turbo path there is nothing to skip and its own README warns it moves composition and motion. Measured 2026-09-20; see WHERE-WE-STAND §7 and studio/_tools/h3_stack_ab.py.
_notes: length must be 17n+5. 124 = ~5.2s, 361 = ~15s. See h3_length() in the builder.
every pixel dimension must be a multiple of 32: the VAE divides by 16 and the model patchifies the latent by 2, so 1280x720 dies inside patchify_video with a reshape error.
the turbo LoRA on node 5 is the v4 step-600 EMA checkpoint, and it is NOT the 4-step v1.0 recipe: its card asks for 8 steps, euler, the beta scheduler and shift_video 12.
sampler is euler and the scheduler is beta - the v4 card's pairing. res_multistep/simple belongs to the v1.0 graph (60/62); do not mix the two halves.

STEPS: the card says 8 and this graph ships 4. Measured 2026-09-20 on three shot types (held close-up, empty market, a figure with a prop): 4 steps held the approved frame as well or better than 8 on every one - drift 0.275 vs 0.308, 0.743 vs 0.793, 0.138 vs 0.156 - for 58s a clip instead of 106s. The card's reason for 8 is audio-sync stability, which that test did not measure and the numbers cannot adjudicate; the 8-step renders did come back 2-4 dB louder. If a shot's sound matters more than its cost, set steps back to 8.
audio comes out of node 41 and is muxed by CreateVideo - there is no separate score to lay under this one.
do NOT call set_negative() on this graph; there is no negative input.
node 7 is the Spectrum patcher; bypass it by rewiring 30 and 32 back to node 6.
warmup_steps and tail_actual_steps reserve real evaluations at both ends of the schedule, so a 4-step run is almost entirely reserved and Spectrum does nothing.
